rating.comments: The student gave '300 days' when asked for days per week, and the AI pointed to that part and explained it needed days per week, then suggested 5 (mostly giving the value). The AI repeated the identical 'Great, that's the number of students' message after the student said '1L', which hurts flow. When the student asked 'no please do it', the AI gave the full answer of 1000 litres instead of offering a smaller scaffold, though the earlier prompt to multiply was a reasonable hint. Tone was polite with generic 'Great' praise but nothing specific.
